meta.notes: LIVE (logged out, headless Chromium, iPhone UA 390x844, 2026-11-08; www.tiktok.com serves the mobile web app, no region wall): / and /foryou (feed with 2 slides, swipe to move on), /discover, /@tiktok, /@tiktok/video/<id>, /search?q=test, /live. /explore redirects to /foryou. Match counts: header button div:has(> div > button[class*=CTAOpenApp])=1 on /; body > div:has(#login-modal)=1 (the 'Get the full app experience / Open TikTok / Not now' modal; present on first load and again after the first swipe, absent on some later loads, so it is session dependent; hiding it removes dim mask too, body overflow is already hidden by the app so no unlock rule); like/comment/share count spans=2 each (two slides); video page: top-banner-open wrapper=1, bottom-banner-open wrapper=1, bottom_banner section=1, play-side-* spans=1 each, recommend-list wrapper=1 (24 items under 'You may like'); the 'Watch this video on TikTok' bottom sheet (.launch-popup-sheet-host)=1 and its 'Continue on web' link=1 were seen on the first video load only (session dependent, not on later loads); profile: followers/following/likes stat blocks=1 each, video-views=24, in-flow 'Get the full app experience' cover under the grid=1 (it fades out the last row of thumbnails), fixed bottom-cta popup container=1 (in DOM, invisible when checked); discover: genre cards row=1, 'Selected by TikTok' heading=1, list=1 (4 items), float button 'Discover more'=1. Hidden element screenshots confirmed on the video page (all banners and the sheet gone, player and caption intact) and on the feed (modal and Open app pill gone, swipe still worked). SELECTOR CAVEAT: two rules use a readable styled-components name via [class*=] (CTAOpenApp, DivFloatButtonWrapper); TikTok has no data-* hook there and the hash part of the class is never matched. INFERRED: tiktok-cookie-banner is a custom element present on every page but empty from this region (host height 0, shadow root holds only an empty cookie-setting-modal), so the cookie rule is a best-effort hide of the element and was not seen covering content; EU banners were not observed. Left alone on purpose: search (logged out the results area stays blank), /live (a content catalogue; hiding live shelves would empty the page), hamburger menu (About/Careers links), Log in button, bottom tab bar, follow buttons. NOT verified: logged-in pages, comments (none rendered logged out), ads or sponsored items (none seen in the logged-out feed), notification prompts, TikTok Shop, desktop layout (a non-mobile UA gets a different app), timed pop-ups beyond ~60 s.
